lines.beaver_en: The new team leader talks so bluntly.
lines.learner: 무뚝뚝하고 사무적이지만 속은 따뜻한 분 같아요.
lines.en: He's curt and businesslike, but warm inside.
lines.roman: Muttukttukago samujeogijiman sogeun ttatteutan bun gatayo.

lines.beaver: 그래요? 회의 때는 좀 권위적으로 보였어요.
lines.beaver_en: Really? He seemed a bit authoritarian in the meeting.
lines.beaver_roman: Geuraeyo? Hoeui ttaeneun jom gwonwijeogeuro boyeosseoyo.
lines.en: That's because he's naturally conservative and rational.

lines.beaver_en: My idea got rejected right away too. I'm upset.
lines.learner: 기발해도 근거 없이 들이밀면 거절당하기 십상이에요.
lines.en: Even clever ideas get rejected if you push them without evidence.
lines.roman: Gibalhaedo geungeo eopsi deurimilmyeon geojeoldanghagi sipsangieyo.

lines.beaver: 그럼 어떻게 하면 좋을까요? 더 말씀해 주세요.
lines.beaver_en: Then what should I do? Tell me more.
lines.beaver_roman: Geureom eotteoke hamyeon joeulkkayo? Deo malsseumhae juseyo.
lines.learner: 숫자로 확실히 보여 주세요. 감정에 호소하면 안 돼요.
lines.en: Show it clearly with numbers. Don't appeal to emotions.
lines.roman: Sutjaro hwaksilhi boyeo juseyo. Gamjeonge hosohamyeon an dwaeyo.

lines.beaver: 저는 그냥 웃으면서 부탁하면 될 줄 알았어요.
lines.beaver_en: I thought I could just ask with a smile.
lines.beaver_roman: Jeoneun geunyang useumyeonseo butakamyeon doel jul arasseoyo.
lines.learner: 애교는 그분한테 안 통해요. 침착하게 말하세요.
lines.en: Charm doesn't work on him. Speak calmly.
lines.roman: Aegyoneun geubunhante an tonghaeyo. Chimchakage malhaseyo.

lines.beaver: 팀장님이 오만한 건 아닐까요? 좀 무서워요.
lines.beaver_en: Isn't he just arrogant? He's a bit scary.
lines.beaver_roman: Timjangnimi omanhan geon anilkkayo? Jom museowoyo.
lines.learner: 오만한 게 아니라 원래 말투가 그런 거예요.
lines.en: He's not arrogant. That's just how he talks.
lines.roman: Omanhan ge anira wollae maltuga geureon geoyeyo.

lines.beaver: 근데 점심은 늘 김밥만 드시던데요. 구두쇠일까요?
lines.beaver_en: But he always eats just gimbap for lunch. Is he a miser?
lines.beaver_roman: Geunde jeomsimeun neul gimbamman deusideondeyo. Gudusoeilkkayo?
lines.learner: 구두쇠가 아니라 소박한 거예요. 기부도 많이 하세요.
lines.en: He's not a miser, just simple. He donates a lot, too.
lines.roman: Gudusoega anira sobakan geoyeyo. Gibudo mani haseyo.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, I didn't know. I judged him too quickly.
lines.learner: 그럴 수 있죠. 좀 더 긍정적으로 봐요.
lines.en: That happens. Try to see it more positively.
lines.roman: Geureol su itjyo. Jom deo geungjeongjeogeuro bwayo.

lines.beaver: 알겠어요. 저는 결정을 잘 못 내려서 걱정이에요.
lines.beaver_en: Okay. I'm worried because I'm bad at making decisions.
lines.beaver_roman: Algesseoyo. Jeoneun gyeoljeongeul jal mon naeryeoseo geokjeongieyo.
lines.learner: 신중한 거죠. 여러 의견을 듣는 건 좋은 거예요.
lines.en: You're just careful. Listening to many opinions is good.
lines.roman: Sinjunghan geojyo. Yeoreo uigyeoneul deunneun geon joeun geoyeyo.

lines.beaver: 고마워요. 덕분에 마음이 편해졌어요. 커피 살게요.
lines.beaver_en: Thanks. I feel better now. Coffee's on me.
lines.beaver_roman: Gomawoyo. Deokbune maeumi pyeonhaejyeosseoyo. Keopi salgeyo.
lines.learner: 좋아요. 힘내서 내일 다시 해 봐요.
lines.en: Great. Cheer up and try again tomorrow.
lines.roman: Joayo. Himnaeseo naeil dasi hae bwayo.
